steps.name: publish
argv:
import hashlib, os, shutil
src = "C:/banyan-farm/attrbind-add-0817"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b05-attrbind-addA-seeds-0817"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
names = [n for i in (2,3,4,5) for n in ("b05-guardA-glassed-s%d.png" % i,
         "b05-guardA-glassed-s%d.png.meta.yaml" % i)] + ["b05-compA.png", "b05-maskA.png"]
got = []
for n in names:
    p = os.path.join(src, n)
    if os.path.isfile(p):
        shutil.copy2(p, os.path.join(dst, n)); got.append(n)
with open(os.path.join(dst, "SHA256SUMS.txt"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    for n in got:
        h = hashlib.sha256(open(os.path.join(dst, n), "rb").read()).hexdigest()
        fh.write("%s  %s\n" % (h, n))
print("published", len(got), "of", len(names), got)
raise SystemExit(0 if len([g for g in got if g.endswith(".png") and "glassed" in g]) == 4 else 1)
